verdict.rationale: GitLab clearly ships CI/CD ('Build and test your application'). The evidence also shows teams running their own CI workers: a community user describes self-hosted CI workers, and a GitLab page mentions one-click installing GitLab Runner to a cluster. One cross-project CI/CD management mention hints at centralized control, but platform-hosted runners and a unified view across runners are not documented. missing for 10: documentation of platform-hosted/managed runners, explicit centralized visibility across hosted and private runners, first-party runner registration/fleet-management docs.
